# CmisCdbStatus — CMIS CDB Status Byte

<!-- Generated by openxcvr-codegen --lang markdown. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Source schema: `schemas/cmis/enums/cdb-status.yaml`

- Schema: `openxcvr.enum.v2` (kind `enum`), id `CmisCdbStatus`
- Description: CdbStatus is an 8-bit status byte with bit 7 indicating busy, bit 6 indicating failed after completion, and bits 5-0 carrying the command result. When bit 7 is set, bit 6 is ignored by the coarse status rules.
- Spec: `cmis` revision `5.3`; errata: `Mapping {"revision": String("1.0"), "source": String("docs/stds/cmis/OIF-CMIS-05-Errata-01.0.pdf")}`
